data.name: Crown Crusade
data.detailed_description:
👑 About This Demo

Crown Crusade is a fast-paced top-down action roguelite where every run shapes a new king.

You are a young ruler who lost everything: your throne, your kingdom, and your army.
Now, armed with steel, magic, and sheer determination, you must fight your way through corrupted lands to reclaim what was once yours.

This Demo features the first region of the game, showcasing the core gameplay loop, progression system, and build variety that define Crown Crusade.

Each run offers new choices, new power combinations, and new ways to survive overwhelming enemy hordes.

⚔️ Key Features

🔥 Build-Defining Power Ups
Choose between powerful upgrades every level and create devastating synergies. No two runs play the same.

🗡️ Multiple Weapons & Playstyles
Wield swords, hammers, bows, daggers and arcane weapons. All compatible with every upgrade.

🧪 Strategic Preparation
Meet unique NPCs during your journey who can craft potions, bless your run or reshape your build.

👑 Skill + Strategy Roguelike Combat
Dash, position and adapt constantly to survive increasingly dangerous encounters.

💀 Challenging Boss Battles
Face powerful guardians standing between you and your lost crown.

🔁 Highly Replayable Runs
Experiment with dozens of upgrade combinations and discover unexpected synergies.

🧭 What’s Included in the Demo

  • The complete first biome

  • Multiple weapons to unlock

  • Dozens of power-ups

  • Unique enemies and two major boss fights

  • Core progression systems

  • Replayable roguelike runs

🚧 Full Game Plans

The full version of Crown Crusade will include:

  • 4 unique biomes

  • Many more enemies and bosses

  • Expanded NPC systems

  • Hundreds of upgrade combinations

  • Permanent progression and unlockables

  • New weapons, abilities and events

❤️ Developer Note

Crown Crusade is being developed by a solo developer passionate about roguelikes and replayability-driven design.

Your feedback during the demo phase directly helps shape the final game.
If you enjoy the experience, please consider adding the game to your wishlist. It makes a huge difference for indie developers.
Thanks and have a fun!

data.short_description: Fight, evolve and reclaim your throne in this fast-paced action roguelike. Combine powerful upgrades, master multiple weapons and parry to survive relentless hordes in a kingdom consumed by chaos.
